tables={}
for i in range(num):
 off=12+16*i; tag=data[off:off+4].decode('latin1'); check,offset,length=struct.unpack('>III', data[off+4:off+16]); tables[tag]=(offset,length,off)
o,l,_=tables['cmap']

ver,n=struct.unpack('>HH',data[o:o+4]); print(ver,n)
for j in range(n):
 platform,enc,sub=struct.unpack('>HHI',data[o+4+8*j:o+12+8*j]); print(platform,enc,sub,data[o+sub:o+sub+32].hex())
